startup_coordination: one suspended reverse port; observer before collector; collector resumes its own endpoint after session start
limits: Tracing, startup coordination, observer and rundown perturb execution.
Managed sampled thread stacks are not kernel CPU/context-switch samples.
Process I/O counters include tracing/IPC; native lane is separate.
prelaunch_hashing_scope: Executable hashing and fixture preparation prime filesystem caches; not cold disk
header_timing_scope: post-resume acknowledgment upper bound; target can run or exit before header is observed

summary.scope: diagnostic sampled native OS counters only, never exact scheduler events or benchmark evidence
summary.initial_coverage: first successful snapshot; startup before it is not event-traced
summary.timing_clock: perf_counter_ns; legacy monotonic_ns is distinct and must not be joined to QPC
summary.flush_policy: flush each JSON line; no fsync/power-loss guarantee

capabilities.scheduler: per-thread cumulative schedstat and context-switch samples; not event trace
capabilities.schedstat_zero_policy: raw zero is not evidence of no wait; require supported/enabled counters
capabilities.io_scope: logical/syscall and accounted storage counters if supported, not file latency
